title: Coefficient module category and abelian global sections on a small ringed site
statement: Let $(\mathcal C,J)$ be a site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], small in a common coefficient universe $u$ [def-weil-size-convention], and let $R$ be a sheaf of commutative rings with values in that universe. Define $\operatorname{Mod}_R(\mathcal C)$ to be the category of sheaves of modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] over the underlying sheaf of rings of $R$, with modules valued in universe $u$. Define $\Gamma_R:\operatorname{Mod}_R(\mathcal C)\to\operatorname{Ab}$ by forgetting the module structure to the underlying abelian sheaf and taking its global sections. Explicitly its elements are families $(m_U)_{U\in\mathcal C}$ with $m_U\in M(U)$ compatible with every restriction, with pointwise abelian-group operations; a module morphism acts componentwise on these families. No terminal object of $\mathcal C$ is required.
